sum: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index is based on a rules-based methodology overseen and implemented by the WisdomTree U.S. Dividend Index Committee. It is non-diversified.
